help_menu: ✨ Videl Music Command & Help Menu Select a category button below to explore commands:
help_admins: 👑 Admin Commands: /pause - Pause the ongoing stream /resume - Resume paused stream /skip - Skip to next track in queue /stop - Stop streaming and clear queue /replay - Replay currently playing track /seek [sec] - Seek forward in track /seekback [sec] - Seek backward in track /loop [1-10/off] - Loop current stream /volume [1-200] - Adjust volume /speed [0.75-2.0] - Adjust playback speed /shuffle - Shuffle playlist queue /reload - Reload admin cache
help_auth: 🛡 Auth Commands: Authorized users can control music without admin permissions. /auth [reply/id] - Authorize a user /unauth [reply/id] - Remove user from auth /authlist - Show authorized users
help_blist: 🚫 Blacklist Commands: Restricts users or chats from interacting with the bot. /blacklist [chat_id/user_id] - Blacklist target /unblacklist [chat_id/user_id] - Remove blacklist
help_lang: 🌐 Language Commands: /lang - Choose your preferred bot language
help_ping: ⚡ Ping & Diagnostics: /ping - Check latency & server status /stats - Show bot usage & resource stats
help_play: 🎵 Play Commands: /play [song name/URL/reply] - Play audio /vplay [video query/URL/reply] - Stream video /playforce or /vplayforce - Force play track immediately /cplay - Play channel/group stream Supports YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud & Telegram Files!
help_queue: 📋 Queue Commands: /queue or /playing - Display current queue & status /lyrics [song name] - Fetch song lyrics
help_stats: 📊 Bot Stats: /stats - Show active chats, users, and CPU/RAM usage
help_sudo: ⚡ Sudo Commands: /ac - Active voice chats count /activevc - List of active voice chats /broadcast - Broadcast message globally /eval - Evaluate Python expressions /sh - Execute bash commands /logs - Get runtime logs /restart - Restart Videl bot /addsudo - Add sudo user /rmsudo - Remove sudo user
